# Flip Flop Solutions

> SEO operations team for US small businesses. Documented checklists, weekly audit cycles, and a methodology refined across hundreds of active websites. Technical SEO, AI content strategy, generative engine optimization, link building, migrations, and free audits.

## What we do

Flip Flop Solutions runs SEO operations the way it should have been done the whole time. We use documented pre-launch and post-launch checklists, transparent monthly reporting, and methodology refined across thousands of audit cycles. We work month-to-month with no long contracts. AI tooling savings pass through to clients as lower prices, not higher margin. Everything we produce is owned by the client from day one.

## Services

- [Technical SEO](https://flipflopsolution.com/technical-seo): Schema implementation, Core Web Vitals, crawl health, indexation, redirects, internal linking.
- [AI and Content Strategy](https://flipflopsolution.com/ai-content-strategy): Entity-based content for Google rankings and LLM citation.
- [Generative Engine Optimization](https://flipflopsolution.com/geo): Get cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini.
- [Link Building](https://flipflopsolution.com/link-building): Editorial outreach, citation building, local press. No PBNs.
- [Migrations and Replatforming](https://flipflopsolution.com/tech-infrastructure): Documented migration process. 150+ migrations with zero traffic loss.
- [Free SEO Audit](https://flipflopsolution.com/neural-scan): Pre-launch checklist run against your live site. 48-hour turnaround.
